purpose: Verify that Faculty, Dept_Admin, and HOD users can each create and publish a department announcement.
preconditions: A department exists with authenticated users holding active Faculty, Dept_Admin, and HOD roles.
action_or_input: Each of the Faculty, Dept_Admin, and HOD users submits a valid department announcement with target role, program, and academic year.
expected_result: Each announcement is created, persisted, and published as an active department announcement.

purpose: Verify that a Student is denied permission to create or publish a department announcement.
preconditions: An authenticated Student user exists in the department.
action_or_input: The Student attempts to create and publish a department announcement.
expected_result: The request is rejected with an authorization error and no announcement is created.

purpose: Verify that publishing a new announcement notifies relevant Students and Faculty within the target scope and excludes out-of-scope users.
preconditions: Students and Faculty exist both inside and outside a specific target scope (role, program, academic year).
action_or_input: An authorized user (Faculty, Dept_Admin, or HOD) publishes a new department announcement targeted to that scope.
expected_result: A notification (real-time system notification and/or email) is dispatched to matching Students and Faculty, and no notification is sent to users outside the target scope.

purpose: Verify that announcement visibility filtering includes announcements matching the viewer's role, program, and academic year.
preconditions: An active announcement exists with target scope matching a specific role, program, and academic year; an authenticated user matches all three attributes.
action_or_input: The matching authenticated user queries the department announcements list.
expected_result: The matching announcement is returned in the filtered results.

purpose: Verify that announcement visibility filtering excludes announcements that do not match the viewer's role, program, or academic year.
preconditions: Three active announcements exist that differ from an authenticated viewer's attributes in role, program, and academic year respectively.
action_or_input: The authenticated viewer queries the department announcements list.
expected_result: None of the three announcements with mismatched role, program, or academic year are returned to the viewer.

purpose: Verify that authenticated department users can view details of announcements relevant to them after visibility filtering.
preconditions: An authenticated Student and an authenticated Faculty user exist, each with at least one active announcement matching their relevance scope.
action_or_input: Each authenticated user requests to view their relevant department announcements.
expected_result: Each user successfully retrieves and views the relevant announcement content.

purpose: Verify that unauthenticated users cannot view department announcements.
preconditions: At least one active department announcement exists; the requester is not authenticated.
action_or_input: An unauthenticated client requests the department announcements list or detail endpoint.
expected_result: Access is denied with an authentication/authorization error and no announcement data is returned.

purpose: Verify that the HOD can edit any active department announcement, including announcements authored by other users.
preconditions: An active department announcement created by a Faculty or Dept_Admin user exists; an authenticated HOD exists for the department.
action_or_input: The HOD submits updated content for the active department announcement.
expected_result: The announcement is updated and the modified content is persisted and visible to relevant viewers.

purpose: Verify that non-HOD users are denied permission to edit arbitrary active department announcements.
preconditions: An active department announcement exists; authenticated Faculty, Dept_Admin, and Student users exist.
action_or_input: A non-HOD user attempts to edit the active department announcement.
expected_result: The edit request is rejected with an authorization error and the announcement remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that the HOD can hide any active department announcement.
preconditions: An active department announcement visible to relevant users exists; an authenticated HOD exists for the department.
action_or_input: The HOD performs the hide action on the active announcement.
expected_result: The announcement is marked hidden and is no longer visible to relevant department viewers.

purpose: Verify that non-HOD users are denied permission to hide active department announcements.
preconditions: An active department announcement exists; authenticated non-HOD users exist.
action_or_input: A non-HOD user (Faculty, Dept_Admin, or Student) attempts to hide the active announcement.
expected_result: The request is rejected with an authorization error and the announcement remains active and visible.

purpose: Verify that the HOD can delete any active department announcement.
preconditions: An active department announcement exists; an authenticated HOD exists for the department.
action_or_input: The HOD performs the delete action on the active announcement.
expected_result: The announcement is deleted from active department announcements and is no longer visible to viewers.

purpose: Verify that non-HOD users are denied permission to delete active department announcements.
preconditions: An active department announcement exists; authenticated non-HOD users exist.
action_or_input: A non-HOD user (Faculty, Dept_Admin, or Student) attempts to delete the active announcement.
expected_result: The request is rejected with an authorization error and the announcement remains active.

purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin can insert stock records into the department inventory.
preconditions: An authenticated Dept_Admin exists for the department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin inserts a new stock record with a valid item identifier and positive quantity into the department inventory.
expected_result: The stock record is persisted in the department inventory.

purpose: Verify that users without the Dept_Admin role cannot insert stock records into department inventory.
preconditions: Authenticated Faculty, HOD, and Student users exist in the department.
action_or_input: A non-Dept_Admin user attempts to insert a stock record into the department inventory.
expected_result: The request is rejected with an authorization error and no stock record is created.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-008 current inventory state and quantity
purpose: Verify that the system accurately maintains current inventory state and quantity for department stock items across stock insertions.
preconditions: An authenticated Dept_Admin exists; a department stock item has an initial quantity of 10.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin inserts an additional quantity of 5 for the same department stock item and queries the item's inventory state.
expected_result: The item's maintained inventory state reflects an updated current quantity of 15.

purpose: Verify that every stock insertion is recorded in the stock-movement log.
preconditions: An authenticated Dept_Admin exists for the department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin inserts a stock record for a department item with quantity 20.
expected_result: A corresponding insertion entry recording the stock item and inserted quantity is created in the stock-movement log.

purpose: Verify that stock-insertion entries in the stock-movement log are immutable and cannot be modified or deleted.
preconditions: A stock insertion has been recorded in the stock-movement log.
action_or_input: A user (including Dept_Admin or HOD) attempts to edit or delete the recorded stock-insertion log entry.
expected_result: The modification and deletion attempts are rejected, and the original stock-insertion log entry remains intact.

purpose: Verify that a Faculty member can submit a stock request for a department inventory item.
preconditions: An authenticated Faculty member exists and a department inventory item has available quantity 10.
action_or_input: The Faculty member submits a stock request for quantity 3 of the department inventory item.
expected_result: The stock request is accepted and recorded in pending status awaiting HOD approval.

purpose: Verify that non-Faculty users (such as Students) are denied permission to submit department stock requests.
preconditions: An authenticated Student exists and a department inventory item has available stock.
action_or_input: The Student attempts to submit a stock request for the department inventory item.
expected_result: The request is rejected with an authorization error and no stock request is created.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-010 valid quantity at inventory boundary
purpose: Verify that a Faculty stock request whose requested quantity equals the current available inventory quantity passes validation and proceeds to HOD approval.
preconditions: An authenticated Faculty member exists and a department inventory item has current available quantity 5.
action_or_input: The Faculty member submits a stock request for quantity 5.
expected_result: The request passes inventory validation and is accepted as pending HOD approval.

purpose: Verify that a Faculty stock request exceeding the current available inventory quantity is rejected before reaching HOD approval.
preconditions: An authenticated Faculty member exists and a department inventory item has current available quantity 5.
action_or_input: The Faculty member submits a stock request for quantity 6.
expected_result: The request fails inventory validation, is rejected, and does not proceed to pending HOD approval.

purpose: Verify that the HOD can approve a pending Faculty stock request.
preconditions: A validated Faculty stock request exists in pending HOD approval status; an authenticated HOD exists for the department.
action_or_input: The HOD approves the pending stock request.
expected_result: The stock request transitions to Approved status.

purpose: Verify that the HOD can reject a pending Faculty stock request.
preconditions: A validated Faculty stock request exists in pending HOD approval status; an authenticated HOD exists for the department.
action_or_input: The HOD rejects the pending stock request.
expected_result: The stock request transitions to terminal Rejected status.

purpose: Verify that non-HOD users cannot approve or reject a pending Faculty stock request.
preconditions: A validated Faculty stock request exists in pending HOD approval status; authenticated Dept_Admin and Faculty users exist.
action_or_input: A non-HOD user attempts to approve or reject the pending stock request.
expected_result: The request is rejected with an authorization error and the stock request remains pending.

purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin can issue stock for a request that has been approved by the HOD.
preconditions: A Faculty stock request has been approved by the HOD; an authenticated Dept_Admin exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks the HOD-approved stock request as Issued.
expected_result: The stock request transitions to final Issued status.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-012 block issuance without HOD approval
purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin cannot issue stock for a request that is still pending or has been rejected by the HOD.
preconditions: One Faculty stock request is in pending status and another is in Rejected status; an authenticated Dept_Admin exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to mark the pending request and the rejected request as Issued.
expected_result: Both issuance attempts are blocked/rejected, request statuses do not change to Issued, and inventory quantities remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify that users without the Dept_Admin role cannot issue an HOD-approved stock request.
preconditions: A Faculty stock request is in Approved status; authenticated Faculty and HOD users exist.
action_or_input: A non-Dept_Admin user attempts to mark the approved stock request as Issued.
expected_result: The issuance attempt is rejected with an authorization error and the request remains Approved.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-013 automatic inventory decrement on issuance
purpose: Verify that issuing approved stock automatically decrements the relevant inventory item quantity.
preconditions: A department inventory item has current quantity 12; a Faculty stock request for quantity 4 of that item is approved by the HOD.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks the approved stock request as Issued.
expected_result: The inventory item's current quantity automatically decreases from 12 to 8.

purpose: Verify that every stock issuance is recorded in the stock-movement log.
preconditions: A Faculty stock request for quantity 3 is approved by the HOD; an authenticated Dept_Admin exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin issues the approved stock request.
expected_result: A corresponding issuance entry recording the stock item and issued quantity is created in the stock-movement log.

purpose: Verify that stock-issuance entries in the stock-movement log are immutable and cannot be modified or deleted.
preconditions: A stock issuance has been recorded in the stock-movement log.
action_or_input: A user (including Dept_Admin or HOD) attempts to modify or delete the recorded stock-issuance log entry.
expected_result: The modification and deletion attempts are rejected, and the original stock-issuance log entry remains intact.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-041 Dept_Admin notification on new stock request
purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin receives a real-time system notification and/or email when a new stock request is submitted.
preconditions: An active Dept_Admin and an authenticated Faculty member exist; an inventory item has sufficient stock.
action_or_input: The Faculty member submits a valid stock request.
expected_result: A real-time system notification and/or email is sent to Dept_Admin referencing the new stock request.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-042 HOD notification on stock request requiring authorization
purpose: Verify that the HOD receives a real-time system notification and/or email when a stock request requires HOD authorization.
preconditions: An active HOD and an authenticated Faculty member exist; an inventory item has sufficient stock.
action_or_input: The Faculty member submits a stock request that passes inventory validation and enters pending HOD authorization.
expected_result: A real-time system notification and/or email is sent to the HOD indicating the request requires authorization.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-043 Faculty notification on Issued outcome
purpose: Verify that the requesting Faculty member is notified when their stock request reaches the final Issued outcome.
preconditions: A Faculty stock request is approved by the HOD; Dept_Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks the approved stock request as Issued.
expected_result: A notification (real-time system notification and/or email) is sent to the requesting Faculty member reporting the Issued outcome.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-043 Faculty notification on Rejected outcome
purpose: Verify that the requesting Faculty member is notified when their stock request reaches the final Rejected outcome.
preconditions: A Faculty stock request is pending HOD approval; HOD is authenticated.
action_or_input: The HOD rejects the pending stock request.
expected_result: A notification (real-time system notification and/or email) is sent to the requesting Faculty member reporting the Rejected outcome.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-043 no Faculty notification on intermediate HOD approval
purpose: Verify that the requesting Faculty member is not sent a final-outcome notification merely upon intermediate HOD approval before issuance.
preconditions: A Faculty stock request is pending HOD approval; HOD is authenticated.
action_or_input: The HOD approves the pending stock request (without Dept_Admin issuing it yet).
expected_result: No final-outcome notification is sent to the requesting Faculty member upon intermediate HOD approval.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-016 Faculty view relevant issued-stock history
purpose: Verify that a Faculty member can view their relevant issued-stock history.
preconditions: Issued stock records exist for Faculty A and for another Faculty member (Faculty B), along with a non-issued request for Faculty A.
action_or_input: Authenticated Faculty A queries their issued-stock history.
expected_result: Faculty A sees their relevant issued-stock records and does not see unrelated issued-stock records belonging to Faculty B.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-017 authenticated Student and Faculty feedback submission
purpose: Verify that authenticated Students and Faculty can submit department feedback.
preconditions: An authenticated Student and an authenticated Faculty member exist in the department.
action_or_input: Both the Student and the Faculty member submit department feedback entries.
expected_result: Both feedback submissions are accepted and stored in the department feedback records.

purpose: Verify that unauthenticated users cannot submit department feedback.
preconditions: The requester is not authenticated.
action_or_input: An unauthenticated client attempts to submit department feedback.
expected_result: The submission is rejected with an authentication/authorization error and no feedback record is created.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-018 confidentiality enforcement against unauthorized viewers
purpose: Verify that submitted feedback is protected as confidential and inaccessible to users outside authorized feedback-handling scope.
preconditions: A Student submits confidential feedback; another Student and a Faculty member (neither being Dept_Admin nor HOD) are authenticated.
action_or_input: The other Student and the Faculty member attempt to list or retrieve the submitted feedback.
expected_result: Access is denied or the confidential feedback is excluded from results so unauthorized users cannot view it.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-044 Dept_Admin notification on new feedback
purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin is notified when new department feedback is submitted.
preconditions: An active Dept_Admin and an authenticated Student or Faculty member exist.
action_or_input: The Student or Faculty member submits new department feedback.
expected_result: A notification (real-time system notification and/or email) is sent to Dept_Admin regarding the new feedback submission.

purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin can perform the initial review of newly submitted feedback.
preconditions: A newly submitted feedback item exists awaiting initial review; an authenticated Dept_Admin exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin opens the newly submitted feedback and performs the initial review action.
expected_result: The feedback item's state reflects completion of initial review by Dept_Admin.

purpose: Verify that users without the Dept_Admin role cannot perform the initial review of newly submitted feedback.
preconditions: A newly submitted feedback item exists awaiting initial review; authenticated Student, Faculty, and HOD users exist.
action_or_input: A non-Dept_Admin user attempts to perform initial review on the newly submitted feedback.
expected_result: The action is rejected with an authorization error and the feedback remains unreviewed.

purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin can categorize feedback during the initial review.
preconditions: A newly submitted feedback item exists; an authenticated Dept_Admin is performing initial review.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin assigns a category to the feedback item during initial review and saves.
expected_result: The assigned category is persisted on the feedback record.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-021 Dept_Admin close simple feedback during initial review
purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin can close a feedback item considered a simple issue during initial review.
preconditions: A newly submitted feedback item exists; an authenticated Dept_Admin is performing initial review.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks the feedback item as Closed during initial review.
expected_result: The feedback item transitions directly to terminal Closed status.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-022 Dept_Admin and HOD terminal resolution or closure
purpose: Verify that both Dept_Admin and HOD can mark reviewed feedback as Resolved or Closed.
preconditions: Reviewed feedback items exist; authenticated Dept_Admin and HOD users exist for the department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks one reviewed feedback item as Resolved and another as Closed; HOD marks one reviewed feedback item as Resolved and another as Closed.
expected_result: Each feedback item transitions to the corresponding terminal Resolved or Closed status.

purpose: Verify that Students and Faculty cannot mark department feedback as Resolved or Closed.
preconditions: A feedback item exists; authenticated Student and Faculty users exist.
action_or_input: A Student or Faculty user attempts to mark the feedback item as Resolved or Closed.
expected_result: The attempt is rejected with an authorization error and the feedback status remains unchanged.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-023 HOD access after initial review
purpose: Verify that the HOD can access feedback after Dept_Admin initial review for oversight and resolution actions.
preconditions: A feedback item has completed initial review by Dept_Admin; an authenticated HOD exists for the department.
action_or_input: The HOD views the reviewed feedback item and performs a resolution/oversight action.
expected_result: The HOD successfully retrieves the reviewed feedback details and can execute resolution actions on it.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-023 HOD access before initial review restricted
purpose: Verify that the HOD cannot access newly submitted feedback for oversight/resolution prior to Dept_Admin initial review.
preconditions: A newly submitted feedback item has not yet undergone initial review by Dept_Admin; an authenticated HOD exists.
action_or_input: The HOD attempts to access or resolve the unreviewed feedback item.
expected_result: Access or resolution action is denied/unavailable until Dept_Admin completes initial review.

purpose: Verify that the feedback submitter is notified when their feedback is marked Resolved.
preconditions: A feedback item submitted by a Student or Faculty member has undergone initial review.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin or HOD marks the feedback item as Resolved.
expected_result: A notification (real-time system notification and/or email) is sent to the original submitter indicating the Resolved status.

purpose: Verify that the feedback submitter is notified when their feedback is marked Closed.
preconditions: A feedback item submitted by a Student or Faculty member exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin (during or after initial review) or HOD marks the feedback item as Closed.
expected_result: A notification (real-time system notification and/or email) is sent to the original submitter indicating the Closed status.

purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin can manage Faculty, Student, and Alumni profile records within the department.
preconditions: An authenticated Dept_Admin exists along with Faculty, Student, and Alumni users in the department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin creates or updates profile records for a Faculty member, a Student, and an Alumni member within the department.
expected_result: All profile record changes for Faculty, Student, and Alumni are persisted.

purpose: Verify that users without the Dept_Admin role cannot manage department Faculty, Student, or Alumni profile records.
preconditions: Authenticated Student and Faculty users exist in the department.
action_or_input: A Student or Faculty user attempts to modify another department user's profile record.
expected_result: The request is rejected with an authorization error and the profile record remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that Students can view basic permitted profile information for peer Students and Faculty.
preconditions: An authenticated Student, a peer Student, and a Faculty member exist in the department with basic, detailed, and sensitive profile fields populated.
action_or_input: The authenticated Student requests the profiles of the peer Student and the Faculty member.
expected_result: The Student receives the basic permitted profile information (such as Name and Program where applicable) for both the peer Student and Faculty member.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-025 Student restricted from detailed or sensitive fields
purpose: Verify that Students are prevented from viewing detailed or sensitive profile fields of peer Students and Faculty.
preconditions: A peer Student and a Faculty member have detailed and privacy-protected sensitive profile fields populated; an authenticated Student exists.
action_or_input: The authenticated Student requests the profiles of the peer Student and the Faculty member.
expected_result: Detailed non-basic fields and sensitive personal data fields are omitted or denied in the response.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-026 Faculty detailed view for enrolled course Students
purpose: Verify that Faculty can view detailed profile information for Students enrolled in the Faculty member's courses.
preconditions: A Faculty member teaches Course C; Student S1 is enrolled in Course C and has detailed profile information populated.
action_or_input: The authenticated Faculty member views Student S1's profile.
expected_result: The Faculty member receives the detailed profile information for Student S1.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-026 Faculty restricted for Students not in their courses
purpose: Verify that Faculty are not granted detailed course-student profile visibility for Students not enrolled in their courses.
preconditions: A Faculty member teaches Course C; Student S2 is in the department but not enrolled in any course taught by the Faculty member.
action_or_input: The authenticated Faculty member requests the detailed profile of Student S2.
expected_result: Detailed course-student profile fields for Student S2 are withheld or access to the detailed view is denied.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-027 Faculty limited-scope view of Faculty and Alumni
purpose: Verify that Faculty can view permitted limited-scope profile information for peer Faculty and Alumni without exposing restricted fields.
preconditions: An authenticated Faculty member, a peer Faculty member, and an Alumni member exist with limited-scope and restricted/sensitive fields populated.
action_or_input: The authenticated Faculty member views the profiles of the peer Faculty member and the Alumni member.
expected_result: Only the permitted limited-scope profile fields are returned; restricted and sensitive fields are excluded.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-028 HOD and Dept_Admin full non-sensitive profile view
purpose: Verify that HOD and Dept_Admin can view full department user profiles excluding privacy-protected sensitive personal data.
preconditions: Authenticated HOD and Dept_Admin users exist; department Faculty, Student, and Alumni profiles contain full non-sensitive fields.
action_or_input: Both HOD and Dept_Admin retrieve department user profiles.
expected_result: Both HOD and Dept_Admin receive the full non-sensitive department profile fields for Faculty, Student, and Alumni users.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-028 exclusion of sensitive personal data
purpose: Verify that privacy-protected sensitive personal data is excluded when HOD or Dept_Admin views department user profiles.
preconditions: A department user profile includes fields classified as privacy-protected sensitive personal data; authenticated HOD and Dept_Admin exist.
action_or_input: HOD and Dept_Admin each request the department user's profile.
expected_result: Privacy-protected sensitive personal data fields are omitted/redacted from the responses returned to both HOD and Dept_Admin.

purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin can upload a conflict-free class and lab timetable.
preconditions: An authenticated Dept_Admin exists for the department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin uploads a valid class and lab timetable with non-overlapping slots.
expected_result: The timetable is saved and persisted in the department records.

purpose: Verify that non-Dept_Admin users cannot upload department class or lab timetables.
preconditions: Authenticated Faculty, Student, and HOD users exist.
action_or_input: A non-Dept_Admin user attempts to upload a department timetable.
expected_result: The upload is rejected with an authorization error and no timetable is saved.

purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin can modify existing class and lab timetables without requiring separate approval.
preconditions: An existing saved class/lab timetable exists; an authenticated Dept_Admin exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin modifies a slot in the existing timetable to a conflict-free time/room and saves.
expected_result: The modified timetable is saved and takes effect immediately.

purpose: Verify that non-Dept_Admin users cannot modify existing department timetables.
preconditions: An existing saved class/lab timetable exists; authenticated Faculty, Student, and HOD users exist.
action_or_input: A non-Dept_Admin user attempts to modify the existing timetable.
expected_result: The modification is rejected with an authorization error and the existing timetable remains unchanged.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-031 block overlapping slots on timetable save
purpose: Verify that overlapping timetable slots are detected before saving and block the save on both upload and modification.
preconditions: An authenticated Dept_Admin exists; an existing timetable contains a slot on Monday 09:00-10:00 for a given room/lab or batch.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to upload or modify a timetable containing a conflicting overlapping slot (e.g., Monday 09:30-10:30 for the same room/lab or batch).
expected_result: The system detects the slot overlap, returns a conflict validation error, blocks saving, and leaves existing saved timetable data unchanged.

purpose: Verify that adjacent non-overlapping timetable slots (sharing only a boundary timestamp) are not flagged as conflicts and save successfully.
preconditions: An authenticated Dept_Admin exists; an existing timetable contains a slot on Monday 09:00-10:00.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin saves a timetable adding an adjacent slot on Monday 10:00-11:00 for the same room/lab or batch.
expected_result: No slot overlap conflict is reported and the timetable is saved successfully.

purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin can update department lab equipment and resource profile details.
preconditions: A department lab resource profile exists; an authenticated Dept_Admin exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin updates the lab equipment and resource profile details and saves.
expected_result: The updated lab equipment and resource profile details are persisted.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-034 non-Dept_Admin lab resource update denial
purpose: Verify that non-Dept_Admin users cannot update department lab equipment and resource profile details.
preconditions: A department lab resource profile exists; authenticated Faculty and Student users exist.
action_or_input: A Faculty or Student user attempts to update the lab resource profile details.
expected_result: The request is rejected with an authorization error and the lab resource profile remains unchanged.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-035 Faculty view lab resource profiles
purpose: Verify that Faculty members can view department lab resource profiles for planning.
preconditions: Department lab equipment/resource profiles exist; an authenticated Faculty member exists.
action_or_input: The authenticated Faculty member queries the department lab resource profiles.
expected_result: The Faculty member retrieves and views the current lab equipment and resource profile details.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-036 Student view academic program information
purpose: Verify that Students can view department academic program information.
preconditions: Department academic program information is populated; an authenticated Student exists.
action_or_input: The authenticated Student requests the department academic program information.
expected_result: The Student successfully retrieves and views the department academic program information.

purpose: Verify that Students can view class and lab timetable information applicable to them.
preconditions: Published class/lab timetables exist for the Student's applicable program/year; an authenticated Student exists.
action_or_input: The authenticated Student requests their applicable class/lab timetable information.
expected_result: The Student successfully retrieves and views the applicable class and lab timetable.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-038 Dept_Admin update general department information
purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin can update general non-official department information directly.
preconditions: Department details exist; an authenticated Dept_Admin exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin updates general non-official department information and saves.
expected_result: The general department information is updated and published immediately without requiring HOD approval.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-038 non-Dept_Admin general info update denial
purpose: Verify that non-Dept_Admin users cannot update general department information.
preconditions: Department details exist; authenticated Faculty and Student users exist.
action_or_input: A Faculty or Student user attempts to update general department information.
expected_result: The update is rejected with an authorization error and the general department information remains unchanged.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-039 official change kept pending before HOD approval
purpose: Verify that proposed official department-detail changes (such as Name or Core Policies) remain pending and are not published prior to HOD approval.
preconditions: Published official department details (e.g., Name and Core Policies) exist; an authenticated Dept_Admin exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin proposes an update to an independently editable official department detail (such as department Name or Core Policies).
expected_result: The proposed change is stored in pending status, and the published department Name/Core Policies remain unchanged until HOD approval.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-039 reject independent Headship edit via official-detail path
purpose: Verify that Headship identity cannot be independently proposed or modified through the official department-detail change path.
preconditions: A department has an active HOD role assignment; an authenticated Dept_Admin exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to submit an official department-detail change modifying the department's Headship identity.
expected_result: The request is rejected/disallowed and no pending Headship detail change is created.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-040 HOD approve official detail change
purpose: Verify that HOD approval of a pending official department-detail change makes the change effective and published.
preconditions: A pending official department-detail change (e.g., Core Policies update) proposed by Dept_Admin exists; an authenticated HOD exists.
action_or_input: The HOD approves the pending official department-detail change.
expected_result: The change transitions to Approved and the updated official department detail becomes effective and published.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-040 HOD reject official detail change
purpose: Verify that HOD rejection of a pending official department-detail change retains the current published department data.
preconditions: A pending official department-detail change (e.g., Name update) proposed by Dept_Admin exists; an authenticated HOD exists.
action_or_input: The HOD rejects the pending official department-detail change.
expected_result: The pending change is marked Rejected and the previously published official department data is retained unchanged.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-040 non-HOD official change decision denial
purpose: Verify that non-HOD users cannot approve or reject a pending official department-detail change.
preconditions: A pending official department-detail change exists; authenticated Dept_Admin and Faculty users exist.
action_or_input: A non-HOD user attempts to approve or reject the pending official department-detail change.
expected_result: The decision is rejected with an authorization error and the proposed change remains pending.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-047 central authority assign HOD and Dept_Admin roles
purpose: Verify that the central Institute Admin (or equivalent authorized authority) can assign HOD and Dept_Admin roles to institute employees for a department.
preconditions: An authenticated central Institute Admin and eligible institute employees exist for a department.
action_or_input: The central Institute Admin assigns the HOD role to Employee A and the Dept_Admin role to Employee B with valid time-bounded periods.
expected_result: Both role assignments are created and associated with the department.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-047 unauthorized department actor role assignment denial
purpose: Verify that department actors (HOD, Dept_Admin, Faculty, Student) cannot assign HOD or Dept_Admin roles.
preconditions: Authenticated HOD, Dept_Admin, Faculty, and Student users exist.
action_or_input: A department actor attempts to assign the HOD or Dept_Admin role to an institute employee.
expected_result: The request is rejected with an authorization error and existing role assignments remain unchanged.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-048 time-bounded role validity period persisted
purpose: Verify that active HOD and Dept_Admin role assignments store and maintain a time-bounded validity period.
preconditions: An authenticated central Institute Admin and an eligible institute employee exist.
action_or_input: The central Institute Admin creates an HOD or Dept_Admin role assignment specifying valid start and end validity bounds.
expected_result: The role assignment is persisted with the specified time-bounded validity period.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-048 reject missing or invalid validity period
purpose: Verify that HOD or Dept_Admin role assignments without valid time bounds (missing bounds or end date before start date) are rejected.
preconditions: An authenticated central Institute Admin and an eligible institute employee exist.
action_or_input: The central Institute Admin attempts to create an HOD or Dept_Admin assignment with no validity period, and again with an end date earlier than the start date.
expected_result: Both attempts are rejected with a validation error and no invalid role assignment is saved.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-049 immediate access revocation for outgoing role holder
purpose: Verify that outgoing HOD or Dept_Admin role access is immediately revoked when a reassignment or transfer takes effect.
preconditions: Employee A is the active HOD (and Employee C is the active Dept_Admin); the central Institute Admin reassigns HOD to Employee B (and Dept_Admin to Employee D) effective immediately.
action_or_input: Immediately after the reassignment takes effect, outgoing Employee A attempts an HOD-only action (e.g., approving a stock request) and outgoing Employee C attempts a Dept_Admin-only action (e.g., inserting stock).
expected_result: Both actions by the outgoing role holders are immediately denied with an authorization error.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-050 immediate access grant for incoming role holder
purpose: Verify that incoming HOD or Dept_Admin role access is immediately granted when a reassignment or transfer takes effect.
preconditions: The central Institute Admin reassigns HOD from Employee A to Employee B and Dept_Admin from Employee C to Employee D effective immediately.
action_or_input: Immediately after the reassignment takes effect, incoming Employee B performs an HOD-only action (e.g., approving a pending stock request) and incoming Employee D performs a Dept_Admin-only action (e.g., inserting stock).
expected_result: Both actions succeed immediately under the newly granted roles.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-051 prevent multiple concurrent active HODs
purpose: Verify that the system prevents a department from having more than one active HOD role assignment concurrently.
preconditions: A department already has one active HOD role assignment for Employee A; an authenticated central Institute Admin exists.
action_or_input: The central Institute Admin attempts to add a second concurrent active HOD assignment for Employee B without replacing or ending Employee A's active assignment.
expected_result: The request is rejected with a constraint violation error, and the department continues to have exactly one active HOD.

purpose: Verify that the system prevents a department from being left with zero active HOD role assignments.
preconditions: A department has exactly one active HOD role assignment for Employee A; an authenticated central Institute Admin exists.
action_or_input: The central Institute Admin attempts to deactivate or end Employee A's active HOD assignment without an active replacement HOD.
expected_result: The operation is blocked/rejected so that the department is not left with zero active HOD assignments.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-052 prevent multiple concurrent active Dept_Admins
purpose: Verify that the system prevents a department from having more than one active Dept_Admin role assignment concurrently.
preconditions: A department already has one active Dept_Admin role assignment for Employee C; an authenticated central Institute Admin exists.
action_or_input: The central Institute Admin attempts to add a second concurrent active Dept_Admin assignment for Employee D without replacing or ending Employee C's active assignment.
expected_result: The request is rejected with a constraint violation error, and the department continues to have exactly one active Dept_Admin.

purpose: Verify that the system prevents a department from being left with zero active Dept_Admin role assignments.
preconditions: A department has exactly one active Dept_Admin role assignment for Employee C; an authenticated central Institute Admin exists.
action_or_input: The central Institute Admin attempts to deactivate or end Employee C's active Dept_Admin assignment without an active replacement Dept_Admin.
expected_result: The operation is blocked/rejected so that the department is not left with zero active Dept_Admin assignments.

source_id: AFR-DEPT-053 displayed Headship derived from active HOD assignment
purpose: Verify that the department's displayed Headship is automatically derived from the current active HOD role assignment maintained by the central authority.
preconditions: Employee A is the current active HOD for the department; the central Institute Admin reassigns the active HOD role to Employee B effective immediately.
action_or_input: Query the department's displayed details before and immediately after the HOD reassignment takes effect.
expected_result: Displayed Headship shows Employee A before reassignment and automatically updates to show Employee B once the new active HOD assignment takes effect.
